label: live

steps.assertion: The Pro project terminal opens in its registered dedicated checkout.
The dev-madrid device terminal uses the existing relay and prints the actual remote hostname.
Type or dictate a command and Run send echo hello through the real PTY.
Sticky Ctrl and C interrupt sleep within two seconds and preserve its non-zero exit record.
Reload reconnects the same terminal and replays hello in its scrollback.
The copy buttons include exactly the requested command range and strip every escape code.

record-2


$ echo record-3
record-3


$ echo record-4
record-4


$ echo record-5
record-5


$ echo record-6
record-6

steps.assertion: Send to… delivers the last command to the coordinator and starts its next turn.

screens.expected: a browser terminal attached to a resumed native coding session, past setup and trust dialogs, with usable exit controls

cosmetic: The workspace path in the header is cut off with an ellipsis ('.../worktrees/live_day_a75f...'). The full path can't be read, but nothing else is affected.
Conversation titles and subtitles in the sidebar are cut off with ellipses (e.g. 'Context · Live invoices and ...', 'Blocked · Live invoices and cus...').
Every project row in the sidebar has the same name ('Live invoices and customers'), so you can only tell them apart by their badges.
The terminal shows a stop hook error ('/Users/ggomes/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.0/bin/node: not found'). This is a session environment problem, not a layout problem, and the session stays usable.

observations: Usage records come from runtime-reported turn outcomes. Missing tokens or cost remain unknown; minutes include concurrent sessions.
